subject: general
question: Rovers Cup is associated with which game?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rovers Cup **is associated with **Football.**
 
• It is an **annual football tournament** that takes place in India.
 
• **The tournament was started in 1891 by the British Army regiment known as the Rovers.**
 
• The tournament has seen some of the top football clubs in** India** participate over the years.
 
• The current champions of the Rovers Cup are the** Mohun Bagan Athletic Club.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tennis has tournaments like Wimbledon, the US Open, the French Open, the Australian Open, etc.**
 
• **Badminton has tournaments like the All England Open, World Championships, Sudirman Cup, Thomas Cup, Uber Cup, etc.**
 
• **Hockey has tournaments like the Hockey World Cup, Champions Trophy, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, etc.**
